failure_type: collision due to late-appearing obstacle and high UAV speed
explanation: The UAV collided with an obstacle after 10.2 seconds of flight, resulting in a minimum clearance of -0.03 meters. The failure was primarily caused by a late-appearing obstacle and high cruise speed, as confirmed by counterfactuals showing that removing the popup or reducing speed by 30% would have prevented the collision. Additionally, sensor noise and planner randomness contributed to the failure, as re-seeding the planner or eliminating noise also prevented the crash.
